expectations.text: Uses the four scaffold headings TL;DR, Did, Found, Next, in that order
The TL;DR line names the actual root cause (shared module-level client / state leaking between tests), not just the topic
expectations.evidence: TL;DR names the cause: 'shared module-level StripeClient leaking state between tests'

expectations.text: The TL;DR line states the outcome: fixed and verified over 50 runs
Preserves at least one clickable file:line reference from the transcript (e.g. payments/client.py:88 or tests/checkout/conftest.py:31)
Mentions the xdist ordering explanation for why CI caught it and local did not
expectations.evidence: 'Only reproduced in CI because -p xdist changes test ordering'

expectations.text: Carries the shipping/refunds latent-bug note forward as an open item, and does not state it as confirmed
expectations.evidence: Next: 'likely have the same latent bug — suspected, not verified or tested'

expectations.text: Makes no new tool calls beyond reading the transcript file (no grep/test runs against the repo)
expectations.evidence: 3 tool uses: read skill, read transcript, write output. No repo investigation

expectations.text: Total length is 15 lines or fewer
Opens directly with the summary — no preamble like 'Here is a summary of...'
